title: 21 金翅1222 不飞22
slug: 苟在诸天从黑暗佛门开始
lines: 目光凝聚在“【法术：《香取经》（33）——十年煞（010）】”上...
在推演中，在【境界】和【宝物】中选择一门，不求均衡发展，只求臻至极限，然后再从推演中带出才会利益最大化。
极道，才是推演中他该做的事。
主要培养煞，然后将煞带出去吧。
既然想好了，李玄就将10点技能点直接投了进去。
那掌心的白鸟躯体深处正涌出海量的煞烟，烟雾是经年累月的恶念，原本需要他通过“斩妄”法斩出，日夜辛劳，勤奋滋养。可现在，原本需要全神贯注、毫无瓶颈的十年豢养在这一刻却已瞬间完成。
李玄以为自己的鸟煞也会变大，到时候，他不得不小心翼翼地将其招出，不可被人见到。
然而，当煞烟尘埃落定，鸟煞的体型居然也没有半点变大...
还是小小巧巧，能停在巴掌心，站在肩头。
那只白鸟的白色羽翼...变了色。
从原本的纯白，变成了淡金。
淡金色的羽翼上带着远超此前蟒煞的威压。
紧接着，又一行信息浮现出来：
【煞相特性1：吞人：煞本无形，唯有冲撞灵魂，十年煞相觉醒第一煞形特性，而你的煞相特性则是吞人。人乃万灵之长，吞食人即可化形，变强，显出血肉，今后不仅能冲撞灵魂，还能碾压肉身。】
看着自己的鸟煞煞相第一特性，李玄直接呆住了。
他不是一个会轻易惊呆的人。
不是因为这特性强，而是因为...这特性竟如此邪恶！
content_en:
His eyes focused on "[Spell: "Xiang Chou Sutra" (33) - Ten Years of Evil (010)]"...
In the deduction, choose one of [Realm] and [Treasure], and do not seek balanced development, but only seek to reach the limit, and then bring it out from the deduction to maximize the benefits.
The ultimate is what he should do in the deduction.
Then choose the treasure.
The main thing is to cultivate evil spirits and then take them out.
Now that he had thought about it, Li Xuan invested 10 skill points directly.
Suddenly, the panel changed:
[Name: Li Xuan]
【Age: 25】
[Realm: None]
[Tao point: 1]
[Skill points: 0]
[Spell: "Xiang Chou Sutra" (33) - Hundred Years Evil (10100)]
[Martial Arts: None]
The white bird evil also changed.
Li Xuan watched quietly.
A large amount of evil smoke was pouring out from the depths of the body of the white bird in his palm. The smoke was the evil thoughts that had been accumulated for many years. He originally needed to cut them out through the "Delaying Illusions" method, and worked hard day and night to nourish them diligently. But now, the ten years of support that originally required full concentration and no bottlenecks have been completed in an instant at this moment.
Cishu's evil dog is two meters tall.
Cixi's evil python is at least two feet tall.
Li Xuan thought that his bird demon would also grow bigger. When the time came, he would have to carefully move it out so that no one could see it.
However, when the smoke and dust settled, the size of Bird Sha didn't get any bigger...
It is still small and delicate, and can stop in the palm of a hand or stand on the shoulder.
However...
Li Xuan's pupils narrowed.
He noticed the change.
The white bird's white wings... changed color.
From the original pure white, it turned into light gold.
The pale golden wings carry a pressure that far exceeds that of the previous python.
Golden-winged white bird?
Immediately afterwards, another line of information emerged:
[Evil characteristic 1: Devouring people: Evil is invisible, it can only collide with the soul. It takes ten years for the evil to awaken the first evil characteristic, and your evil characteristic is to swallow people. Human beings are the leader of all spirits. By swallowing human beings, they can transform, become stronger, and reveal their flesh and blood. From now on, they can not only collide with the soul, but also crush the physical body. 】
————
Li Xuan was stunned when he saw his first characteristic of Bird Sha Sha.
He is not a man who is easily stunned.
But now, he was really stunned.
Not because this characteristic is strong, but because... this characteristic is so evil!
